oncall-bot: INCIDENT: kubelet_restart_spike detected in cluster: infer-usw-1. 6 nodes NotReady, autoscaler triggered. Pager routed to #eng-oncall. severity=high tags=[kubelet,notready,inference]
Alex (oncall): seeing 5-10% 5m error rate uptick for inference routes. some 503s from the serving runtime.
Priya (eng-sre): confirmed node flaps in infer-usw-1. kubelet logs show repeated `E kubelet.go:... failed to checkin` and `out of memory` messages around driver unload. attaching quick log: `kubelet: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address` (snippet).
Jordan (runtime): runtime shows a bunch of container restarts on those nodes, CUDA driver resets on node GPUs. tail latency spikes on model-large.
Alex (oncall): pushing quick mitigation steps — please call them out.
Priya (eng-sre): immediate: cordon + drain the 6 NotReady-ish nodes to stop new pods landing: `kubectl cordon <node>` `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` 
Jordan (runtime): also enabling fallback routing to infer-fallback-pool (cpu-backed) for lowest-tier customers to reduce tail latency. will flip at the LB layer.
Marta (support): heads up — Support: some customers started reporting 5xxs and slow responses. I'll post in #support-updates and DM top customers. any ETA?
Alex (oncall): Priya / Jordan — how long to remediate kubelet root cause?
Priya (eng-sre): quick triage: kernel+driver mismatch after an automated driver deploy earlier today. rollback candidate available. plan: roll driver to previous version on affected AZ, then reboot nodes gracefully. estimate 20-30m for staged rollback + node rejoin.
Jordan (runtime): in parallel I'll reduce model-large replicas in infer-usw-1 and shift traffic to infer-usw-2 and infer-dedicated fallback. also lowering request concurrency on affected pools to avoid OOMs.
Alex (oncall): good. please keep channel updated on each step. I'm opening an incident in the tracker and will add runbook links.
infra-bot: Deploy rollback started: driver-rollback/v1.2.3 -> in_progress on nodegroup infer-usw-1-a (3 nodes)
Priya (eng-sre): rolling driver rollback in batches of 3 nodes. first batch healthy and rejoined at +8m. still draining second batch now.
Jordan (runtime): runtime metrics look better for requests routed to usw-2. tail p95 down ~300ms vs peak. still seeing some 500s from requests that hit re-created pods on rejoining nodes.
Marta (support): updated customers in #support-updates with workaround (re-route to another region, or use smaller model variant). Some asked for SLA credit; escalating to customer success lead.
Alex (oncall): status check?
Priya (eng-sre): all driver rollbacks complete on infer-usw-1, nodes rejoined. kubelet stable for ~12m. marking nodes schedulable. removing cordon on recovered nodes.
Jordan (runtime): restored replica counts, rebalanced pods. no further CUDA resets observed in logs.
Alex (oncall): closing mitigation: routing restored, error rates back to baseline. will keep incident open for postmortem. Great job — followup: add preflight check to driver deploys to avoid kernel mismatch, and add probe to detect early kubelet panic patterns.
Marta (support): customers notified of resolution.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated -> monitoring. incident_id=INC-2026-0423-07
Alex (oncall): assigning postmortem owners: Priya + Jordan. I'll kick off blameless postmortem doc and include timeline + customer impact.
Priya (eng-sre): noted. ping me for any logs you need.
Jordan (runtime): will attach runtime traces and pod restart histograms.
Marta (support): I'll compile list of affected accounts and CS notes.
Alex (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: we can close the paging rotation for this alert once postmortem is filed.
